patches.reason: Tailwind shadow utilities compile to literal offsets, so elevation cannot reach through a variable. Physical-direction utilities do not mirror in RTL; their logical equivalents resolve identically in LTR. Animating without a reduced-motion guard ignores the user's stated preference.

A fixed Tailwind spacing step cannot follow the design system's spacing scale; the Balsa step carries the same value and derives from the base unit. Physical-direction utilities do not mirror in RTL; their logical equivalents resolve identically in LTR.

portal: Teleports content. The adapter scope does not follow a teleport, so put data-balsa-adapt on the teleport target as well as the application root.
findings: Uses physical-direction utilities (left-), which do not mirror in RTL.
limitations: Control heights stay on the upstream scale; Balsa density is not a Tailwind grid unit.
Type scale stays on the upstream scale; Balsa defines no numeric type scale.
The Glass material is not applied; material direction is a composition decision.
